name: urgeaway-app-lock
description: Local Capacitor plugin: Lock In Mode for UrgeAway. Uses Android's standard, user-granted Accessibility Service API (window-state change events + the documented GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME action) to send a chosen app back to the Home screen for a duration the person sets themselves. Does NOT use Device Owner/Device Policy Manager, ADB, root, or PackageManager#setComponentEnabledSetting() on another app's components (that call only works on an app's own components on stock Android). Reads no on-screen content and never hides or blocks the system Accessibility toggle that turns it off.
